IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE TO LICENSEE ... FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES (one-way only)

reasons: Locked target is fallback, and every atomic fallback element is present: the cap in (b) is now mutual and set at an amount equal to 12 months' fees, and new (d) places indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap.

Preferred is correctly not attempted: no USD 1,000,000 floor, no 'paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim' measure, no mutualisation of the consequential-damages exclusion in (a), and no data protection/security, fraud or IP-infringement carve-outs or payment-obligations clause. The fallback numeric threshold is not inflated with a preferred-only amount.

Minimality holds: the edit is a targeted replacement of the one-sided cap sentence plus one concise inserted paragraph supplying the absent carve-outs; no untouched sentence was rewritten and no boilerplate was added.
Intent preserved: Articles XII and XIII(a) and (c) remain effective and no contradiction or dangling mechanic is introduced.

Note for the rationale (not a deviation at this level): because Article XII gives only a one-way Licensee indemnity, the mutual indemnification carve-out in (d) principally uncaps our own liability; and 'fees' is not a defined term in the excerpt, so tying the cap to fees paid or payable under the Agreement in the 12 months preceding the claim would sharpen it. Paragraph (a) also remains a one-way exclusion of consequential damages in Licensor's favour.
